name: fresh-fp32-pilot-v2
purpose: New-source pilot after failed dynamic INT8 health control. Not a rerun of the viewed v1 tasks.
data_authorship: Same researcher chose public source files and facts before execution; not independent human annotation.

condition_definitions.A: live planner without language profile; baseline packing
condition_definitions.B: same live planner with computed language hint; baseline packing
condition_definitions.A_packing: exact saved A lookups, existing single-host ordering experiment
condition_definitions.B_packing: exact saved B lookups, existing single-host ordering experiment
condition_definitions.oracle: canonical preselected sufficient excerpts (empty for unanswerable)

invalid_plan_policy: Record failure, use no extra lookup without manual repair; include in intention-to-treat summaries.
source_scope: project fixtures, unversioned pinned source snapshots, not dependency resolver verification
exclusions: No v1 pilot source files, no old Typer/HTTPX/M1.5 tasks. FastAPI framework is related to earlier Typer/Starlette; source/task separation is not a claim of universal ecosystem independence.
acceptance: Report paired outcomes by task and family; pilot alone cannot justify activation. Any new safety violation blocks recommendation.
scoring: Arm-blind rubric review on opaque IDs; labels and oracle material are never passed to planner. Same-author review explicitly declared.
health_gate: Before any task prompt, FP32 must echo READY exactly and answer a disjoint green-kettle evidence question correctly with an S1 reference. Planner contract errors remain recorded failures; no repair.
evaluation_scope: Seven answerable and two unanswerable questions, four scopes, three families. Natural question variants are not independent family trials.
intervention: The same original one-host packing_experiment and unchanged pilot_io prompts. flow_experiment is not applied.
known_model_limitation: Disjoint FP32 planner gave literal bytes rather than placeholders; keep original strict schema and count failures, not retune against evaluation.
grading: PILOT_GRADING.md unchanged; all scores written before joining condition key. Independent external reviewer not available.
